items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: After we broke up the five clique, we had the three clique, In Kansas City... Can you use him?

ctx.x: Well, see, Paul Weber is a trumpet player, Eddie Thompson is a trumpet player. After we broke up the five clique, we had the three clique, In Kansas City, like, you call up and say, Eddie Thompson, I'd like to play for my band tonight. Say, I can't play, I got all trumpet or all trombone. Can you use him?
Well, who was left in the three clique?
